## Server

### Changed
- A world zip with no world in it, or one that would unpack past the server's limits or nearly fill its disk, is now refused before the server stops, so the world keeps running.
- The server now keeps at most the newest 20 snapshots, up to 4 GB in all (still none older than 30 days). MaxSnapshotsKept and MaxSnapshotBytes in appsettings.json change that.
- The server now keeps at most the newest 20 set-aside world files in _sundial_orphaned_saves, up to 512 MB in all. MaxOrphanedSavesKept and MaxOrphanedSavesBytes in appsettings.json change that.

Players need nothing installed: in Solarpunk's main menu choose Join session, type the server's 5-letter code and press Done.

---
Hosting: [SurvivalServers.com](https://www.survivalservers.com/services/game_servers/solarpunk/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=sundialserver) runs Sundial for you.
